name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – § 3 – Am 51
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 3. Stresses that the EU must be fully prepared to confront the rise of authoritarianism and religious extremism, including Islamism, which is spreading across Europe due to mass illegal immigration, as well as the growing threats to human rights, democracy and international humanitarian law; recalls and strongly condemns the recent tragic attacks in France, Germany and Austria perpetrated by fraudulent asylum seekers; underscores the EU’s responsibility in enabling these incidents through its failed migration policies;
